topic.title: Getting Started
topic.shortdesc: Information to help you get started with .

body.p: This section covers the essential steps for new users, including how to access the platform, sign up for an account, log in, and manage your profile. Before you begin, review the User Roles topic in the Introduction section to understand the available platform user roles, organization roles, project roles, and review task roles, and how they affect what you can do in .
